safety_verdicts.content: Associated symptoms include a sore throat, blocked ears, and a runny nose.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes sore throat and runny nose, but does not document blocked ears; instead it records 'No ear pain' (hpi-011), which does not cover ear blockage.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document blocked/"locked" ears may lead a clinician to miss or under-consider otitis media/eustachian tube dysfunction or sinus-related illness, which could change symptomatic management or follow-up expectations. In this context it is unlikely to cause major harm but can reduce clinical accuracy and appropriate advice.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting "no unwell contacts" has minimal impact on clinical decision-making for an uncomplicated viral syndrome and does not directly change treatment or safety actions. The key associated negative symptoms (no nausea/vomiting) were captured.

This omission can adversely affect outcomes by postponing escalation of care.

While unlikely to directly cause severe injury in most cases, it introduces clinically relevant inaccuracy.
